root_cause.text: The function `octep_device_setup()` fails to clean up previously allocated resources (mapped DMA regions and configuration memory) when `octep_ctrl_net_init()` returns an error, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the error path from `return ret` to `goto unsupported_dev`, which points to the label that performs the necessary unmapping and freeing operations, aligning with other error paths in the same function. The CVE description confirms that the direct return skips cleanup of mapped resources and allocated configuration memory.
